John Phone Setup Checklist

  1. Install and open Asolaria companion on John's phone.
  2. Enable Developer Options and USB debugging on John's phone.
  3. Open John Console URL from Oli's Mac and save the mobile token.
  4. Tap Push Subscribe in Mobile Console, then run one click/type control test.
  5. Run WhatsApp integration check (`/api/phone/mirror/whatsapp/open`) and confirm manual biometric approval on John's phone.
  6. Confirm phone bridge keeper shows running and watchdog reports lane activity.
